name: sagemaker-a2i-runtime
description: Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I) adds the benefit of human judgment to any machine learning application.

subcommands.name: delete-human-loop
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified human loop for a flow definition.

subcommands.name: describe-human-loop
subcommands.description: Returns information about the specified human loop.

subcommands.name: list-human-loops
subcommands.description: Returns information about human loops, given the specified parameters.

subcommands.name: start-human-loop
subcommands.description: Starts a human loop, provided that at least one activation condition is met.
